description: Local functional acceptance and the user-approved local clear (design §12.10, §12.11, §8.4; review NIT N2). Plan items 16-19. Runs after FEAT-001..004. Exercises every create/read/update/delete/add-content operation of the Aadhaar surface end to end on the local stack including failure paths, proves key isolation, then clears the LOCAL dev Aadhaar data with clear_aadhaar.py and records counts. Nothing touches AWS, dev or prod.
steps: Plan item 16 — run the whole local check set and record exact results: bun run typecheck; bun test packages/core apps/web/src apps/mobile/tests apps/university/src; every scripts/*-tests.ts + icon-guard + ux-guards + parity-check; cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs; .local/gateway-venv/bin/python -m pytest services/gateway/tests -q; ai-boundary-guard; swift DocSpineTests; e2e spec 07 Aadhaar tests.

Plan item 17 precondition — `lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -iTCP:8081 -iTCP:8082 -iTCP:5173 -iTCP:5180 -iTCP:5181 -sTCP:LISTEN`. If any listener exists that this task did not start, DO NOT run start-local.sh (it kills those listeners): call send_message severity 'warning' asking whether to proceed, or record the live steps NOT RUN.

Plan item 17 — start scripts/start-local.sh in the background (LOCAL_AUTH=mock is acceptable to avoid hosted sign-in); wait for API health. Startup variants (each followed by a clean stop): (a) normal; (b) .local/cognito-local.env temporarily renamed (mv, restore immediately after; never read it) -> API healthy, no 'unbound variable' in output; (c) .local/aadhaar-key.env temporarily renamed (restore after) -> banner names the missing file, a synthetic scan returns 503 with UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE and .local/api.log shows no provider dispatch. N2 isolation (count only, never inspect 8080/API): for port in 8082 8081 <web port printed by the script> 5181; do for p in $(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); do printf '%s ' $port; ps eww -p $p | grep -c 'AADHAAR_ENC_KEY='; done; done -> every line ends 0; repeat once with a throwaway synthetic Fernet key exported in the launching shell. API key proven by behaviour: no 'aadhaar.write_path_missing' in .local/api.log with the file present.

Plan item 17 — end to end with a synthetic card you generate (PDF or PNG showing the fake name 'Test Person', DOB 01/01/1990, number 1234 1234 1234; never a real card; delete it at the end): read via the web flow or the gateway async route -> save member -> member list shows XXXX XXXX 1234 -> edit without Aadhaar keeps it -> replace with typed 567856785678 (old record and vault row gone; verify with count-only SQL on local DB pattadar) -> apply-my-KYC shares one record between users and the self member -> remove member (record and vault row go) -> with the box ticked the card appears in My Drive as 'Aadhaar card.pdf' and aadhaar_candidates.card_node_id is set -> iOS path POST /api/gateway/pattadar/extract-aadhaar (sync) with a local token returns {aadhaarMasked, aadhaarCandidateId}. At most 3 paid reads, never retried; if the API has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, record provider-dependent steps NOT RUN and exercise the rest with typed numbers. Leak checks (counts only): no 12-digit run in .local/api.log, in document_read_jobs.result, in aadhaar_candidates text columns, in captured GraphQL responses; aadhaar_vault.ciphertext all start with 'fernet:v0:'. Stop the stack you started.

Plan item 18 — local clear (user-approved 'Clear existing'; LOCAL ONLY): with the stack stopped, from services/api: export API_DSN='host=localhost port=5432 dbname=pattadar user=rhub', HUB_DSN='host=localhost port=5432 dbname=pattadar_hub user=rhub', PGPASSWORD and MinIO credentials taken from scripts/start-local.sh defaults (never from .local/*.env), STORAGE_BUCKET=pattadar-local-documents, STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:9000 (MinIO container must be running; it is left running by start-local). Run: dry run with --environment local --candidates-out "$(mktemp -u)"; --environment local --execute --cards-linked-first; optional reviewed --card-nodes run (review file contents only by counts; do not print ids in your report); final dry run must report all zeros. Record counts only. Delete the candidates file. NEVER use --environment dev or prod.

Plan item 19 — wrap-up: run the secret-scan skill over staged/unstaged/untracked changes (no commit); confirm every process this FEAT started is stopped and both .local files are back in place; remove scratch artifacts (synthetic card, candidate TSVs, /tmp copies); write findings: checks run with results, NOT-verified items, and open Reddy decisions (D4 opt-in, D11, D3a hardening, iOS sync route and on-device reveal, git-history purge of old fixture values, prod clear §8.5, S3 permission route §9).
